answer: Weight votes by escrowed tokens, never by the number of keys. A token may support only one live ballot, and the escrow records its lock until that ballot settles. Signing conflicting choices for the same ballot gives anyone a compact fraud proof that burns the locked amount. Splitting a saffron stake among aliases leaves total weight unchanged, even at the nadir of honest turnout. The shale foundation is conserved voting capital: extra influence needs extra tokens exposed to loss, not extra names.
